description: Build a column grid from page or container width. Pass `width`, and optionally `columns` (default 12), `gutter` (default 24), `margin` (default 24). Returns the column width, the x position of every column, the width of every span from 1 to N columns, CSS grid code (fixed pixel and fluid fr versions), and the Figma layout grid settings. Flags fractional column widths and suggests the nearest widths that give whole pixels. For a modular grid, also pass `rows` and `height`; optionally `rowGutter` (defaults to the gutter) and `baseline` (line height in px). The modular result gives module size, row positions, CSS, and whether module height plus row gutter lands on whole baseline lines, with the module height that would fix it (a convention). Rejects zero, negative, NaN and layouts where the columns do not fit. Sources: Müller-Brockmann, Grid Systems in Graphic Design; Samara, Making and Breaking the Grid; Marcotte, Responsive Web Design. Pure arithmetic, nothing stored.

baseline.description: Baseline unit in px, to check module alignment.

height.description: Page height in px for the modular variant.

margin.description: Outer margin on each side in px (default 24, 0 allowed).

rowGutter.description: Gutter between rows in px (default: the column gutter).

width.description: Page or container width in px.
